page.overview:
Who is Angel O7?

Angel O7 is a character version of the card "Angel O7". It appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's World Championship 2011: Over the Nexus as a Tag Duel opponent partnered with Naturia Bamboo Shoot. Their Tag Team name is "Forbidding Fellows".
